items.source:
Invoke the given callback on all fields in the target class, going up the
class hierarchy to get all declared fields.
items.translation: 在目标类的所有字段上调用给定的回调，并向上遍历类层次结构以获取所有声明的字段。

items.source:
Miscellaneous utility classes, such as utilities for working with strings,
classes, collections, reflection, etc.
items.translation: 杂项实用工具类，例如用于处理字符串、类、集合、反射等的实用工具。

items.source: Invoke the given callback on all locally declared fields in the given class.
items.translation: 在给定类的本地声明字段上调用给定的回调。
